SuCat is the Erasmus Mundus master in sustainable catalysis delivered by a consortium including Rovira i Virgili University in Tarragona, now opening its application portal on 23 October 2026 for the 2027-2029 intake. The last round closed on 19 February (23:59 Brussels time), a date the 2027 round is expected to mirror.

Programme Highlights

  • Specialised catalysis training with green-chemistry and industry relevance
  • Portal for the 2027-2029 intake opens 23 October 2026
  • Scholarship round historically closes on 19 February (23:59 Brussels time)
  • 30 places per edition with laboratory-heavy, research-driven training

Who Should Apply

Chemistry, chemical engineering and biochemistry graduates with strong organic and physical chemistry fundamentals are the natural applicants.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: tuition coverage plus a monthly allowance (around EUR 1,400).

Deadline and How to Apply

Create your application on the SuCat site after 23 October 2026 and target the February scholarship deadline with reference letters ready early. Key deadline information: 19 February 2027 (23:59 Brussels time, expected); application portal opens 23 October 2026.
